glossary.definition: (1) "Chronic pain" has the same meaning as in section 4731.052 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4731.054 - Operation of pain management clinics; supervision and control of employees, volunteers and contractors.

glossary.definition: (2) "Controlled substance" has the same meaning as in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4731.054 - Operation of pain management clinics; supervision and control of employees, volunteers and contractors.

glossary.definition: (3) "Hospice care program" means a program licensed under Chapter 3712. of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4731.054 - Operation of pain management clinics; supervision and control of employees, volunteers and contractors.

glossary.definition: (4) "Hospital" means a hospital registered with the department of health under section 3701.07 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4731.054 - Operation of pain management clinics; supervision and control of employees, volunteers and contractors.

glossary.definition: (5) "Owner" means each person included on the list maintained under division (B)(6) of section 4729.552 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4731.054 - Operation of pain management clinics; supervision and control of employees, volunteers and contractors.

glossary.definition: (7) "Physician" means an individual authorized under this chapter to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery.
